definition.timing: Defined after 8034839 outcome, original leaf failures and actuator violation were inspected. Post-execution description, not prospectively declared skill acceptance.
definition.scope: Observed effects of this continuous physical trace only. Does not validate arbitrary skill starts, independent low-level leaf contracts, actuator compliance, sensor-only execution, or formal admission.
definition.transport: Adjacent Touch+Push+Retreat interval: both raw hand contacts occur, target progresses toward D on ground with two feet planted, exits released and target speed <.02 m/s. No claim of simultaneous raw contact at nominal Touch exit.
definition.reposition: PlannedSteps and following intermediate ReturnHands: measured bilateral unloaded swings, supported landing and forward displacement, hands released, real following Touch establishes executed contact reachability. Final ReturnHands instead joins final release macro.
definition.release: Final ReturnHands/Retreat/ClearHands/Hold/Recenter/StandUp/Hold: preserve individual measured physical checks; recenter is nonphysical bookkeeping, final geometric goal separated from strict actuator verdict.
definition.preservation: Every original command interval, raw boundary and leaf fail/unknown is referenced without relabeling its success. No command or physics state is changed.

strict_actuator_check.explanation: Original 1 mrad H1 tolerance; v7 erroneously allowed 20 mrad. Original v7 audit is retained and superseded for compliance.

terminal_goal.robot_stability_scope: Measured base velocities; no hidden hand-only or foot-only contact requirement. Actual standing/support contacts are separate reference diagnostics.
terminal_goal.cannot_lift_claim: Only excluded by declared 2 kg lifted-payload rule; physical impossibility is not claimed.

interpretation: These macro rules originate in v2 post-execution analysis and are bound here to a separate frozen contract for a later matching-profile run. Fine-grained leaf failures remain diagnostic and are not called passed. Strict actuator/goal/identity and original five safety rules remain necessary.

prospective_contract.scope: Prospective executable macro skill contract for future matching-profile runs; old leaf predicates retained as diagnostic, not exact leaf-boundary acceptance.
prospective_contract.origin: Rules developed after v2 outcomes; prospectively declared only for later run IDs started after this freeze.

partial_rule4_contact_identity_review.scope: Contact-identity final release only; complete rules use canonical <1 N measured hand force.

limitations: body_ground_force (contact of non-foot robot links with the floor, recorded from 2026-10-21) is accepted but does not enter the fall decision; safety rule 1 counts it as support (kneeling, sitting). trunk_ground_force is rejected if supplied.
Initial foot-load baseline is recorded supported load, not a measured robot mass.
Deep-forward-lean exception requires bilateral floor support; other deeply tilted supported postures are not calibrated.
Thresholds are candidate semantics pending independent physical fall/near-fall calibration.

source_mapping.semantics: RelayStateLogger._relay_contacts: sum each contact magnitude for body/hand/cabinet, signed upward force on robot for feet; zero means query had no matching contacts. All movable objects including parked entities recorded.
